brief: Toyohiko Kagawa was born in 1888 and came to know Christ at the age of fifteen. His prayer was, “O God, make me like Christ.” This prayer led him to live in poverty and to become a tireless worker for social justice, to found trade unions and a peace movement, to evangelise and to write books. His baptism led him into conflict with his family and with the Japanese government. Yet, twice the government called on him to lead the work of reconstruction after national disasters. His limitless love for others marked him out as one who was truly “like Christ”. He died in 1960.
